main_body: Leafy tree canopy (clustered green blobs) on a thin brown trunk with a dark green grass base patch
top_band: Canopy top: lighter green clumps at rows ~2-14 forming a domed leaf mass; the upper canopy reads as a rounded volume with highlights on top, leading to darker lower foliage (rows 14-28)
evidence: Organic tree: the canopy is a volumetric mass lit from above with lighter upper clumps and darker undersides, and the canopy casts a shadowed underside above the trunk. The trunk and the ground shadow patch read as a front view with a ground ellipse. No flat elevation or rim-only problem; organic forms are not required to have a hard edge line. Reads as an acceptable 3/4-style tree.

style.evidence: Canopy has about 5 green steps with dark-green outlines (tinted, not black) and some clump separation, plus a dark green ground patch. But the leaf texture is smoother and blobbier than the references, which have many individual leaf dots and highlights. The trunk is a flat narrow stick of 2-3 browns with no roots, bark grain or branches visible in the canopy, which is thinner than the reference trees. Larger areas of the canopy are broad, similar-tone patches, so overall it is somewhat lower in detail and density than the references.
